messages:
Lina: Quick async — delivery tally for Optimize toolkit. Need current owners for: quantization recommendations, batching/caching changes, and the regression-alert rule set. Who's driving which piece?
Alex: I can own quant recs + model profiles. PR #482 is in review: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/482. Small blocker: 4-bit quant tests failing on llama-13b fp16 path.
Priya: I'll take batching/caching. Working on prefix cache TTL tuning and KV cache eviction heuristics. Plan to land an RFC by EOD Fri.
Marco: I'll own regression alerts/eval hooks. Need the canonical eval prompt set + baseline metrics. @Alex can you push the latest eval bundle?
Alex: Uploaded a trimmed eval set: s3://redwood-opt/evals/optkit-v2.tar.gz. Also pushed a test harness to the PR that reproduces the 4-bit failure. snippet:```bash
pytest tests/quant/test_profiles.py::test_4bit_fp16
# failing on kv-cache mismatch
```
Sam: Heads up — Dedicated cluster maintenance Mon night. I'll reserve 3 warm nodes for canary on Tue-Wed, but if canary needs >10% traffic we should talk capacity.
Priya: Question — what's the latency/regression threshold we should use for alerts? p95 relative or absolute?
Marco: Suggestion: p95 relative to baseline (5% increase sustained over 15m) triggers a warning, and eval_score_drop >= 2.0 points triggers a high severity. We'll tune once we have real signals.
Lina: Good defaults. Action items: Alex -> finish PR + attach eval manifest; Priya -> RFC for cache TTL & eviction; Marco -> alert rules spec + example Grafana alerts; Sam -> reserve nodes and post capacity numbers; I'll add these to the delivery board and follow up in tomorrow async sync. Thanks :raised_hands:
ops-bot: deploy-bot scheduled: optkit-canary v0.9 -> staging at 2026-03-18 09:30 PST (eta: 30m).
Priya: quick one — does anyone have a safe canary config for prefix cache warmup? worried about cold-cache blips.
Alex: put this in the PR notes: start with 5% canary + prefill warmup requests (~1000 prefixes) before traffic shift. Example rollout:```yaml
rollout:
  canary: 5%
  warmup_prefill: 1000
  monitor:
    latency_p95: 1.05*baseline
    eval_drop: ">=2.0"
```
Marco: I'll wire those fields into the alert template (Grafana + PagerDuty). I'll also add a lightweight smoke check that runs eval set vs. baseline before we flip to 100%.
Sam: I'll post node reservation numbers to the delivery board in 30m. If anyone needs more nodes for heavy benchmarking, @Sam please ping ASAP.
Lina: Perfect. If any blockers come up, DM the owners; otherwise we'll reconvene in the weekly delivery thread. Closing this one for now :white_check_mark:
